title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays of Equal Size

content.problemStatement:
Write a program to find the median of two sorted arrays of same size.

For example:

The given array ->1 is : 1 5 13 24 35

The given array ->2 is : 3 8 15 17 32

The median of the 2 sorted arrays is :14

Explanation:

After merging two arrays,we get 1 3 5 8 13 15 17 24 32 35

In the middle two elements are 13 & 15.

Average of these two is (13+15)/2=14

Hence median of these two array is 14.
content.inputFormat:
The first line has an integer N denotes the size, which is same for both the array.

The second line contains N values separated by space

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find median of two merged sorted arrays of equal size N.
solution.editorial: Combine both arrays, sort, and compute average of middle two elements (m1 + m2) / 2.
